literal_meaning: কর্কশ বা চড়া শব্দের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic expression mimicking grating or sharp sound)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা ক্যাঁটক্যাঁটে শুনতে কষ্ট হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His words sound grating and painful to hear.
This color is shrilly piercing to the eyes.
note: This idiom is rooted in Bengali phonetic expressiveness, often used to describe uncomfortable or aggressive tones in everyday language.
